frequencyRange.title: Detected frequency range
frequencyRange.note: Changes apply immediately and clear attack history. Bands may overlap. Range: 20–20,000 Hz, with a minimum width of 10 Hz.

infiniteZoom.skyLightingNote: Sky lighting: high-frequency attacks illuminate bright cloud openings across the sky. Enable React to music; the Glints effect controls intensity.

midAttack.title: Mid-frequency attack · midAttack
midAttack.note: A short mid-frequency impulse from 0 to 1 (default 250–2000 Hz), decaying over 120 ms. No artwork effect assigned yet. Detects attacks in this band, not a specific instrument.
midAttack.inactive: Play music and enable music response and live analysis.

highAttack.title: High-frequency attack · highAttack
highAttack.note: A short high-frequency impulse from 0 to 1 (default 2–16 kHz), decaying over 100 ms. On the alien planet it lights bright cloud openings. Detects attacks in this band, not a specific instrument.
highAttack.inactive: Play music and enable music response and live analysis.

kick.title: Bass attack · kick
kick.note: A short low-frequency impulse from 0 to 1. On the alien planet, each hit drives the building membranes' breathing. With one kick per beat: 100 BPM ≈ 600 ms, 150 BPM ≈ 400 ms. These are detected bass attacks, not BPM measurement or instrument recognition.
kick.inactive: Play music and enable music response and live analysis.

infiniteZoom.rimLightingNote: Enable Glints to see six-second packets on the existing ribs. Texture and shadows remain visible. This switch hides the lighting without restarting the scene.
infiniteZoom.sceneRevealLabel: Reveal the scene from darkness — 60 s
infiniteZoom.sceneRevealNote: Initially shows rim lights and lava. Enables rim lighting; pause freezes the reveal. Disabling immediately restores full brightness.
infiniteZoom.alienDescription: Volcanic wasteland, dense storm clouds and chitinous architecture. Play music to animate lights, breathing membranes, electrical cloud glows, heat refraction and fading vapor.
infiniteZoom.alienNotes: Use Solo to inspect each effect. Curling and wind sway animate the distant right volcano's smoke while its root stays attached to the crater. Enable both with fading to review the combined motion. Refraction affects air above lava. Disabling fading leaves static vapor and smoke visible. Experimental scene without a portal.
infiniteZoom.digitalDescription: A white and black light cycle, luminous roads and hexagonal domes. Light waves travel across panels, wheel rims and city bands.
infiniteZoom.digitalNotes: Geometry stays fixed. Traveling light changes white panel brightness and city colors locally. Test artwork; the source is not native 4K.
infiniteZoom.bassAttackConfigurationNote: Bass attack configuration: shared detector, 160 ms impulse preview and frequency range controls. Bass attacks are not yet assigned to any mask in this artwork.
infiniteZoom.environmentBlackoutNote: Keeps animated colors and lights against black. When disabled, the environment fades back over 3 seconds of playback; pause freezes the reveal.
infiniteZoom.clockworkDescription: A dark machine interior with golden gear wheels. Play music to start the synchronized motion. Pause holds every wheel in its current position.
infiniteZoom.clockworkNotes: Wheels rotate rigidly around fixed axles. Rotation strength changes the common drive speed; disabling it stops the drive without shifting the teeth. Complete backing remains under moving parts.
infiniteZoom.layeredDescription: Water, mist and ferns form one painted scene. Play music to animate it. Each effect can be reviewed on its own.
infiniteZoom.layeredNotes: Wave and flow move the river surface. Fern roots stay planted, with complete ground behind them. Parallax requires camera movement.
infiniteZoom.pilotReplayNote: Switching scenes ends the current replay recording. Reset the journey to start a new recording.
infiniteZoom.pilotDescription: Compare effects on separate layers of one scene. Music starts animation; pause preserves it. Returning to the journey restores its saved camera and transition.
infiniteZoom.pilotCamera: Camera movement — required to test depth (parallax)
infiniteZoom.pilotNotes: Glow is local emission; flow is field deformation. This pilot uses the existing forest artwork and independent plant, pollen, mist and water layers.
infiniteZoom.description: A technical demo using sample artwork. Play music from your library to animate the scene. Pause preserves your journey.
infiniteZoom.failed: The visualization is unavailable or the requested operation is unsafe. Music already playing continues.

bassVisual.title: Bass pulse
bassVisual.description: The circle size shows current bass energy. An expanding, fading glow indicates a detected pulse; stronger pulses produce a stronger glow.
bassVisual.notes: Active during live analysis and playback. Higher sensitivity lowers the bass detection threshold in the measurement fields too. Changing sensitivity or spacing resets detection history. These are pulses in the configured bass range, not verified kick drum recognition. Animated glows are disabled when your system requests reduced motion.

liveAnalysis.title: Live analysis
liveAnalysis.description: Current measurements of the playing track in separate fields, refreshed approximately every 100 ms. No full-file analysis is required.
liveAnalysis.failed: Live analysis could not start. Check Web Audio support in your browser and try again.
liveAnalysis.lastBassStrength: Last bass pulse strength relative to threshold
liveAnalysis.lastOnsetStrength: Last energy increase strength relative to threshold
liveAnalysis.notes: Fields refresh approximately every 100 ms with a 93 ms measurement window. Attacks are detected separately approximately every 20 ms, using a shorter 23 ms window and filtered bass. Glows react immediately; ringing is grouped into one event. Seeking resets history. The browser can delay reads, especially in the background. Tempo requires regular pulses; bars are not inferred. Stopping analysis does not stop playback.

analysis.title: Audio analysis
analysis.description: Analyze the entire recording without playback. Results are computed in your browser and remain available until you leave this page. Click a track title in the Library to open its analysis.
analysis.limits: First version: MP3/WAV, up to 50 MiB and 10 minutes, mono or stereo. Parameters every 100 ms; frequency analysis window approximately 93 ms. Band energy is a percentage of energy between 20 and 20,000 Hz. RMS and Peak measure digital signal levels, not LUFS.
analysis.unsupported: This browser does not support audio analysis.
analysis.limit: The file exceeds analysis limits: 50 MiB, 10 minutes, mono/stereo or the memory budget.
analysis.denied: You do not have access to this recording.
analysis.missing: This recording is no longer available.
analysis.noAudio: This track has no audio file.
analysis.estimates: A bass pulse is an energy increase at 20–250 Hz, not instrument recognition. Tempo is based on pulse regularity and may be half or twice the musical BPM. Beats, meter and bars are not inferred yet. Strength is the increase relative to the detection threshold, not confidence.
analysis.empty: No events detected. Signal parameters are available in the other view.

audioBands.title: Frequency detectors
audioBands.description: Choose a frequency range for each signal. Level follows its energy; attack generates one impulse at the start of a sound.
audioBands.notes: Ranges may overlap. Filters also pick up nearby frequencies and harmonics; they do not identify an instrument or a note. Settings last until reload or sign-out.

audio.title: Audio response
audio.description: Sliders below set the base values. Each mapping adds an audio response to the selected parameter.
audio.selectTrack: Select a track in the library first, then return here.
audio.kickNote: Kick uses the attack of the configured bass range. All attacks detect energy changes in their band, not a specific instrument.
audio.amountHelp: Strength is a percentage of the parameter range added to its base value. Negative values reduce it. Mappings to the same parameter add together; the result stays within its limits. Pause and stop return the animation to its base values.

animations.description: Adjust the settings to see the background animation change live. Settings last until you reload the page or sign out.
